latest_release.name: bla-agents 3.3.1
latest_release.body:
## bla-agents 3.3.1

Opt-in `sidecarEntangle` for **Android DEX string-pool notes** (host-verify), the `REA_INTERNAL_LIMITS.DEX_ARRAY_DIMENSIONS` honesty catalog (REA #10227), plus already-landed post-3.3.0 work (parameterized MBA substitutions, multi-round hypothesis-revision decoys, release-hygiene packaging gate, `verify-sidecar` CLI, technical SEO).

### Added
- `generateSidecarDexStringPoolNote` / `bindDexSidecarEntanglement` / `entangleDexEntryWithSidecars` / `verifyDexSidecarStringPoolNote` / `extractDexSidecarStringPoolNote` / `stripDexSidecarStringPoolNote`
- Alignment-safe `parseDexLayout` / `rebuildDex` plants an unreferenced sort-last `bla.sidecar.v1=` string in the official DEX string pool. Existing string indices and instruction bytes stay unchanged; Adler32 / SHA-1 are recomputed; `protectAndroidDexBuffer` trailers are preserved
- `protectTarget` + `hardenProject` DEX post-pass when `sidecarEntangle` is on (default **OFF**)
- Vector `dex-sidecar-entangle` reserved but **not recorded** until a load-time hook lands (host-verify only; ART/Dalvik ignore the unreferenced pool string)
- defenseScore: `android-dex` joins `SIDECAR_ENTANGLE_FORMATS`; gap `dex-sidecar-host-verify-only` (soft-cap 93)
- `REA_INTERNAL_LIMITS.DEX_ARRAY_DIMENSIONS` = 255 (REA #10227 `dexTypes.ts` admission). Honesty catalog only — not a densify trip target
- Also in this cut (already on main since 3.3.0): parameterized MBA substitutions & unsigned-domain predicates, multi-round hypothesis-revision decoys, release-hygiene packaging gate, `bla verify-sidecar`, `--self-seal-sibling-glob`, technical SEO (`robots.txt`, sitemap, `llms.txt`, OG card)

### Gates
- `npm test`: 883 passed / 4 skipped
- `node dist/cli.js benchmark`: 14/14 runtime-equivalent
- `npm run build`: ok

### Notes
- REA tip `3cb75d46b` (+41 since `a8527d43b`): analyzer correctness, inventory retention, ownership unexports, schema/validation fixes. **No new 1:1 densify counters.** The one new format bound is DEX array dimensions = 255, catalogued as above.

npm publish may be blocked on the nightly box (no npm auth) — GitHub release + tag only.
